title: curie skill eval --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie skill eval --json`: the outcome roll-up plus one row per eval case.

failed.description: Cases the grader FAILED. Counted, never inferred as `total - passed`: a `plumbing_ok` row was never graded and is not a failure.

plumbing_ok.description: Cases that completed on the fake model and so were not graded at all (ADR-0055). Neither passes nor failures; `passed + failed + plumbing_ok == total`.

bundle_digest.description: sha256 of the tar.gz snapshot the evaluated runner mounted (#1087). Always present; null at the local/cluster tiers, which grade a deployed version rather than a locally snapshotted bundle, and on a skill run against a runner this checkout never recorded. Read it against `skill status --json`'s bundle_digest to confirm messaging and eval executed the same bundle.

outcome.description: The case's verdict. `plumbing_ok` is a third state, not a shade of pass or fail: the turn completed on the fake model, which returns one canned reply whatever the input, so no grader was run.

passed.description: Tri-state view of `outcome`: true for pass, false for fail, null for plumbing_ok. A non-graded row claims neither verdict, so it is null rather than a fabricated false.

output.description: The graded answer text (the reply judged). Empty when the turn produced no gradeable text. Carried so a failing case is diagnosable without a re-run (#548).
